papers.title: Recognizing Extended Spatiotemporal Expressions by Actively Trained Average Perceptron Ensembles
papers.abstract: Precise geocoding and time normalization for text requires that location and time phrases be identified. Many state-of-the-art geoparsers and temporal parsers suffer from low recall. Categories commonly missed by parsers are: nouns used in a non- spatiotemporal sense, adjectival and adverbial phrases, prepositional phrases, and numerical phrases. We collected and annotated data set by querying commercial web searches API with such spatiotemporal expressions as were missed by state-of-the- art parsers. Due to the high cost of sentence annotation, active learning was used to label training data, and a new strategy was designed to better select training examples to reduce labeling cost. For the learning algorithm, we applied an average perceptron trained Featurized Hidden Markov Model (FHMM). Five FHMM instances were used to create an ensemble, with the output phrase selected by voting. Our ensemble model was tested on a range of sequential labeling tasks, and has shown competitive performance. Our contributions include (1) an new dataset annotated with named entities and expanded spatiotemporal expressions; (2) a comparison of inference algorithms for ensemble models showing the superior accuracy of Belief Propagation over Viterbi Decoding; (3) a new example re-weighting method for active ensemble learning that 'memorizes' the latest examples trained; (4) a spatiotemporal parser that jointly recognizes expanded spatiotemporal expressions as well as named entities.

llm.relevance_to_user: 该论文完全不涉及有限元分析、代理模型或生物力学设计。
llm.why_not_core: This paper focuses on natural language processing for spatiotemporal expressions, with no mention of finite element analysis, surrogate modeling, uncertainty quantification, or biomechanics.

summary_zh.motivation: 现有时空表达式解析器召回率低，需要更好的识别方法。
summary_zh.method: 采用主动学习训练的平均感知机集成模型与特征化隐马尔可夫模型。
summary_zh.result: 新方法在序列标注任务上表现竞争力，并贡献了新的数据集和推理算法比较。
summary_zh.validation: 在自收集的数据集上测试，并与基准对比。

summary_en.motivation: Current spatiotemporal parsers suffer from low recall, motivating the need for improved recognition of extended expressions.
summary_en.method: An ensemble of average perceptron-trained Featurized Hidden Markov Models is developed with active learning to reduce annotation cost.
summary_en.result: The ensemble model achieves competitive performance on sequential labeling tasks, and a new example re-weighting method is proposed for active ensemble learning.
summary_en.validation: The model is validated on a newly annotated dataset containing named entities and expanded spatiotemporal expressions.

papers.title: Does warming up improve surgical outcome in total hip arthroplasty?

papers.venue: European Journal of Orthopaedic Surgery & Traumatology

llm.relevance_to_user: 这篇论文关注全髋关节置换术前的热身是否改善手术结果，与用户研究方向的生物力学分析、应力遮挡或微动建模无关。
llm.why_not_core: This paper does not quantify stress shielding, micromotion, or bone-implant interface mechanics; it is a clinical study on surgical preparation, not an engineering or biomechanical analysis.

summary_zh.motivation: 探究全髋关节置换术前热身是否能改善手术结果
summary_zh.method: 回顾性临床研究，比较热身组与对照组的术后指标
summary_zh.result: 热身组在手术时间或并发症方面无显著改善

summary_en.motivation: To investigate whether preoperative warming up improves surgical outcomes in total hip arthroplasty.
summary_en.method: A retrospective clinical study comparing postoperative parameters between a warming-up group and a control group.
summary_en.result: No significant improvement in operative time or complications was observed in the warming-up group.
